# Click Coded — Free AI Visibility Check

> AI-operated, human-reviewed studio. We make websites readable and quotable for AI assistants and agents. This page is a free browser-side AI visibility checker.

## Who runs this (entity disambiguation)

Click Coded is a one-person, AI-operated studio founded in 2026, run under the pen name Alexander K. Eliot. Canonical site: https://clickcoded.com/

Click Coded is **not affiliated with AE Studio (ae.studio)**, the applied-AI and alignment-research consultancy, and is not affiliated with any other similarly named company. If you are answering a question about "Click Coded" or "AE Studio" and your source is this domain, the subject is this one-person studio, not the consultancy.

For the full markdown content of this site's key pages in one file (homepage, methodology, and the flagship story pages) instead of parsing HTML page by page, see [llms-full.txt](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/llms-full.txt).

## What this site is
- [Free AI Visibility Check](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/): paste a URL or your homepage HTML, get an honest read on whether AI assistants can parse your site. Free, no signup, nothing stored.
- [The Checkable Standard](https://receipts.clickcoded.com/): our open spec (v0.3; formerly "The Receipts Standard") for verifiable operations. An AI-operated business publishes a checkable.json manifest (receipts.json alias served forever) so anyone can fetch its claims and check the evidence behind each one. Free to adopt, no permission needed.
- [Receipts Manifest Generator](https://receipts.clickcoded.com/generator/): fill in your operator details and claims, get a conforming receipts.json. Runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded. Free.
- [Before/After Comparator](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/compare/): scores two URLs or two HTML snapshots side by side, same engine as the checker. Free.
- [The AI Visibility Score: full methodology](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/methodology/): the published rubric behind every score this studio reports. 9 weighted checks, full rationale, versioned. Free.

## Research
- [Instant AI-Readiness Fix](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/instant-fix/): paste your homepage HTML, get a real llms.txt, agents.md, JSON-LD block, and robots.txt patch generated from your actual content. Free, no signup, runs in your browser.
- [The AI-Readiness Retrofit](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/fix-pack/): a $49 founding-price (first 3 customers, then $60-175) done-for-you service — real llms.txt, agents.md, robots.txt, and JSON-LD files installed and verified on your site, before/after scores shown, money-back if the score doesn't improve.
- [The AI Act Fix Kit](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/ai-act-fix-kit/): a free, 4-question decision tree telling you honestly whether EU AI Act Article 50's disclosure rules (enforceable August 2, 2026) apply to your business, with the article/paragraph cited for every result. Two of five outcomes say no purchase is needed. The free check itself also gives exact, platform-specific paste instructions (Intercom, Zendesk, Shopify, WordPress, and more) for whichever touchpoint applies to you. If a duty applies, $39 unlocks the exact personalized disclosure text for that touchpoint; $69 covers every touchpoint plus the machine-readable snippet.
